test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 26 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: G, H, I, J, K and L live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it is numbered 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6. Only one person lives above G. Only two people live between G and K. Neither J nor H live on the lowermost floor. I does not live on an odd-numbered floor. J lives immediately above K and immediately below H. Who lives on floor number 4?
solution:
**Given: **

G, H, I, J, K and L live on six different floors of the same building.

**Solution:**

(1) Only one person lives above G.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ee4ad3b64a480b2d84aabd44d0a299f2a7e7614f1f480782dfb99b6f5498dc2f.png] 

(2) Only two people live between G and K.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/137a85bab5c301cdd98df5b069c6126f9ec85c90d67d41be43085eb20210709f.png] 

(3) J lives immediately above K and immediately below H AND Neither J nor H live on the lowermost floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/591cb52746df63af4a5983f1fe2935c0b749d420a867945fb27550ca7d250387.png] 

(4) I does not live on an odd-numbered floor.

 
• here the even floor is vacant is the sixth floor.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b7216e3aff47f242d991f0a58bbe0dc86e9f9e49d192d545a7250e4c93f28711.png] 

(5) Unoccupied floor filled by L.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55c442b9ee72a280766695752dd4c67deaafb42c8dc34fb26edd5fd966c409fa.png] 

here, H lives on floor number 4.

**Hence, 'option 3' is the correct answer.**
